observation.text: The simulation’s speech measured B2; the certificate is IELTS 6.5 (B2).

items.whatToDo: Hold the first minutes of the interview in English on an unprepared topic, and ask inVision to check the certificate.
items.askInInterview: In English and without preparing: tell me about the last thing you built and what went wrong.

claim.text: Says they ask everyone before deciding.

evidence.quote: I always ask everyone's opinion before I decide anything.

observation.text: In the test they chose deciding quickly and explaining later.

evidence.quote: I prefer to decide quickly and explain my reasons later.

items.whatToDo: Ask for a recent decision and exactly how it was made.
items.askInInterview: Walk me through the last decision you made for a team. Who did you ask first?

claim.text: Wants to study at inVision U.

evidence.quote: inVision U is where I can learn to do this at a bigger scale.

observation.text: Nothing in the application or the simulation shows what they know about inVision U.

items.whatToDo: Check what they know about the programme and why this university.
items.askInInterview: What do you know about how inVision U teaches, and which part of it made you apply?
